queries: OpenAI HuggingFace ExploitGym incident July 2026 production classifiers

sources_considered.why: Read in full. The original report directly explains the omitted classifiers and the purpose of measuring maximal capability.
Read with read_page. The later investigation confirms that production protections were absent during the July incident.
Read the relevant passage. METR expressly excluded safeguard effectiveness from its investigation, so it cannot independently establish that production safeguards would have prevented the incident.

evidence_items.locator: Section 'What happened during this incident', first paragraph
evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI explicitly connects the omission of production classifiers to measuring maximal cyber capability. This supports Marcus's qualified characterization without implying that the breach itself was staged.

evidence_items.locator: Section 'Safeguard coverage in internal evaluations', paragraph beginning 'First'
evidence_items.explanation: The preceding sentence identifies production system prompts, harnesses, auto-review models, and safety classifiers. The investigation confirms their absence in the incident environment.

unresolved_gaps: The cited evidence does not establish the probability of an equivalent breach under ordinary production safeguards.
